column1: # Groovy definition rule. Recorded: class and enum (class), interface, @interface and trait
# (interface); methods and constructors in a class, interface, trait or enum body (method);
# Spock string-named methods (method, named by the title without quotes); closures assigned to a
# field (method) or to a script variable (function); def and typed functions at the top level of a
# script (function); Gradle tasks (function): task name {}, task name(type: T) {},
# Not recorded: plain fields and script variables, enum constants, locals, parameters, calls,
# configuration blocks (repositories {}, dependencies {}), tasks.named (configures an existing task).
# A class with an annotation starts at the annotation line (Inventory.groovy 5).
# Not captured, see KNOWN_GAPS.md: Inventory.groovy 80-84 (enum constants and constructor).

# Constraints.groovy: a class under an annotation stack with implements, a private static method and a constructor with two typed parameters (read through the mask). Roles.groovy: enum, trait with an abstract method, interface, @interface.
